tasks.subject: Task 1: O texto do "Por quê" em palavras (puro)
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/features/smart-buy/components/aporte/explain.ts`
- Test: `src/features/smart-buy/components/aporte/explain.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**

tasks.subject: Task 5: A tabela com a linha expansível
tasks.description:
